Simmons 654 / Clinton Keeney 650 / Write-Ins 13 / Blanks 477 / Totals 1794" -- and closes "TOTAL NUMBER OF REGISTERED VOTERS 2697 / % VOTER TURNOUT 33%". All eleven contests and every figure in the record are on the page; the record matches it exactly.
why: The document is fine and no reading of it reaches the checks. pdftotext returns a form feed and nothing else; docling wrote 1255 characters of which 1117 are U+FFFD; pdftoppm renders the table rules, the orange header bands and the town seal with not one glyph, so even reading the page image gives nothing. Only PyMuPDF gets the text out, and it warns "cannot find ExtGState resource GS6" doing it -- the file is malformed in a way that defeats every reader the pipeline has. Measured against all 1575 held PDFs, this is the ONLY one where pdftotext yields under 20 words and PyMuPDF yields 50 or more: a class of one, which is why it is an override and not a change to the reader. The durable fix is upstream -- extract this document with PyMuPDF and store the result -- and it retires this row when it lands.
